claims.sentence: You have the right to control the learning process by assigning control works and test tasks that are provided for in the educational program
You have the right to organize forums and online consultations
You have the right not to allow a student who has not mastered the previous module of the educational program to study the next module in the case of sequential learning
You are obliged to assist in processing information and consult students if necessary
You must help students document the results of their independent activities through communication via the internet or any method convenient for you and the student
You must provide feedback during the execution of tasks
This feedback includes clarifying the degree of task completion, answering questions, diagnosing the causes of difficulties, giving recommendations, and helping to determine ways to solve problems
You are obliged to design and carry out high-quality teaching of academic disciplines conducted in a distance learning format
You must timely replenish and edit educational and methodological complexes
You must answer student questions in a timely manner
You must systematically improve your professional qualifications, including in the field of mastering specific tools that allow you to conduct distance learning
As a teacher or curator using distance learning technologies, you also perform the duties of a tutor
Your duties as a tutor include organizing the process of individual work with students
You must assist students in overcoming difficulties in the process of self-education and in mastering new technologies, including those related to the field of distance learning
You must monitor all actions of students
You must support the cognitive interest of the student
You must organize individual and group consultations
